<summary>
Turns 16–18: Agent attempted repo-wide greps for com.sun/toolsjar/systemPath in module poms/sources; due to typos in the grep pattern (“systemPaath”) no useful matches were returned. Agent inspected the local Maven cache POM for com.google.testing.compile:compile-testing:0.7 and confirmed it declares a system-scoped dependency on com.sun:tools with <systemPath>${toolsjar}</systemPath> and profiles that set toolsjar to ${java.home}/../lib/tools.jar (or mac classes.jar). Agent confirmed tools.jar does not exist on the Java 11 install in this environment.

Turns 19–22: Agent inspected module POMs and confirmed compile-testing is used as a test dependency in multiple modules with older versions:
- factory/pom.xml: compile-testing 0.8 (test scope)
- service/pom.xml: compile-testing 0.6 (test scope)
- value/pom.xml: compile-testing 0.6 (test scope)
- common/pom.xml: compile-testing 0.7 (test scope)
These dependencies explain why the build fails resolving com.sun:tools on JDK 11.

Turns 23–24: Agent created /home/travis/build/failed/failed_reasons.txt with analysis: build fails under the Travis verify command (mvn -f build-pom.xml verify) because compile-testing pulls in com.sun:tools via system-scoped tools.jar, which is absent on JDK9+. It also noted a likely next issue: the parent auto-parent:3 sets java.version=1.6 which Java 11 cannot compile with. Proposed plan: exclude com.sun:tools from compile-testing dependencies in the affected modules and override java.version to 1.7 in modules to compile on Java 11.

Turn 25: git status showed the repo is a git work tree; there is an untracked file “build.pom.xml” present.

Turns 26–30: Agent searched for <properties> insertion points in module POMs; only value/pom.xml currently has a <properties> block (guava.version). common/factory/service have no properties blocks near the top, so new properties sections may need to be added. Agent viewed relevant sections of value/pom.xml, common/pom.xml (including the compile-testing dependency block), and factory/pom.xml to identify where to insert exclusions/properties. No patches/diffs have been written or applied yet in this window.</summary>
